scope: Sanitized read-only real-card identity and structure review; separate from historical video measurements.

identity.older_marker_provenance: Prior reviewed Offloader E1 Pro source profile; not observed on this card or in historical media-only directories.
identity.unknown_settings_suffix_policy: Do not reduce unknown suffixes to E1 Pro or E1 Pro S; conflicting exact markers require unresolved identity.

firmware.scope: Owner assertion for the five historical reviewed configurations; not a firmware token recovered from current card settings or container metadata.

filename_grammar.current_card_scope: N_A occurs on Normal-folder videos; P_A occurs on Parking-folder videos and Photo-folder JPG files. Event is empty. No E/T files were observed on this card.
filename_grammar.historical_media_scope: Reviewed owner-attributed media-only samples corroborate E_A and T_A tokens and the shared family grammar. Their identity is not independently established by these filenames.
filename_grammar.channel_scope: A corresponds to the observed/owner-confirmed single front channel; not a sibling-model identifier.
filename_grammar.mode_scope: Tokens and folders do not establish capture rate, configured mode, trigger, pre-buffer, or within-file transitions.

historical_measurement_boundary.policy: Historical dossier, original folder inventories, source observations, configuration cohorts, sample pairings, numerical values and all profile video_samples are unchanged. Current card inventory is not retroactively attributed to those reports.

inspection_limits: One owner-identified mounted card; older E1 Pro marker is prior source evidence, not a second physical-card observation.
No original capture filenames, private paths, receipt identifiers, GPS payloads or configuration contents are included.
Bounded prior support/container inspection found no independent firmware or distinguishing model token; codec, dimensions and FPS are not model identity.
Owner-reported mixed modes remain unverified; no new video measurements, retail specifications, buffer or wake-latency claims are made.

sources.label: Local read-only card review and retained sanitized identity research
sources.provenance: Exact support basename, directory inventory and filename-token counts checked against mounted card; retained review supplies historical shared-grammar and older-marker context. No external product claim added.
